The '''''Bootana Hutta''''', also known as the '''Garden of the Hutts''',<ref name="LoNH" /> was a centralized region of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] that held several [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworlds]], which was unlike the rest of the [[Oversector/Legends|Oversector]], and not directly affiliated with Hutt Space.

==Description==
[[File:BootanaHutta-TEA.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The ''Bootana Hutta'']]
The [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of the ''Bootana Hutta'' were transected by the [[Pabol Hutta/Legends|''Pabol Hutta'']] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|route]] which was guarded by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress worlds]] of [[Mulatan]] and [[Gos Hutta system/Legends|Gos Hutta]] that boasted several Hutt [[Warship/Legends|warships]]. Due to the secretive nature of these worlds, offworlders were rare in this region, and mainly appeared only as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].<ref name="TEA" />

[[Kajidic/Legends|Kajidic]] rivalries were muted within the borders of the ''Bootana Hutta'', and open violence was rare. Many kajidics whose influence had all but evaporated still retained their [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworlds]] as melancholy reminders of their lost status.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
It was rumored that the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] were not able to infiltrate the ''Bootana Hutta'', though the remainder of Hutt Space was devastated. The region was believed to be the source of a mysterious biotechnology that allowed the Hutts to resist the [[Terraforming/Legends|Vongforming]] efforts of the Yuuzhan Vong.<ref name="TEA" />
